name: Tougane Mia
source:
The class president of Class 2-C, which [url=/c78405]Ryoutarou[/url] has transferred to.

Adored by her classmates, she has a bit of a clumsy side that makes everybody worry about her. She’s also a student librarian at the campus library, and often has duties there after class.

“Wanna walk to the next class together?"

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?product_code=1490&af=3a123f6214695bfacaa881bd3117c693]MangaGamer[/url]]
